_about: Projects with a known site, for the satellite-image card. Kept by hand: the queue lists only give the connection station. 'match' picks the queue project(s): every field given must agree (grid; name or one of names; applicant, as a part of the listed one; station; mw to 0.05 MW), text compared without case or accents. 'parcels' are the land parcels (TERYT ids, as in GUNB's register of building permits) that etl/imagery.py outlines and centres the images on, through GUGiK's parcel service; 'lat'/'lon' are used only for a site without parcels. 'half_m' is half the side of the image square in metres (default: fitted to the parcels).
